# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile portrait browser game titled `Afterlife Stripes: Chaos Carnival`. Preserve the mechanics of a free-roam survival collection arena: one-thumb joystick movement, a grab action for nearby relics, a directional scare/attack action, enemy pursuit/contact damage, three health units, score gained by defeating enemies, persistent collection index, game-over overlay, restart, and keyboard fallback.

Transform presentation into a Beetlejuice-inspired spooky-chaos adventure without using licensed names: the player is a striped undead trickster in a crooked afterlife mansion-carnival. Collect grotesque gag relics from a Handbook of Gags, scare bureaucratic ghosts, earn Chaos Tickets, and protect Soul Strings. Use procedural canvas art for striped walls, crooked haunted-house architecture, sandworm-like rings, carnival signs, glowing particles, a distinctive striped focal actor, pale ghost hazards, and mobile-readable HUD cards.

<!-- Creative Remix v5 blueprint filled for Afterlife Stripes. -->

# Source Game Truth
- genre: mobile-first free-roam survival collection arena
- objective: roam a large 2500x2500 world, pick up collectible weapon/relic drops, use the active item or bare attack to defeat pursuing enemies, raise score, and survive with three health units.
- input model: left virtual joystick or WASD/arrow keys for analog movement; GRAB/keyboard E-K claims a nearby item; SCARE/space-J attacks in the facing direction.
- core loop: start run, spawn player plus relics and enemies, move camera with player, collect items, discover entries in the index, attack enemies, score on enemy defeat, enemies spawn faster as score rises, game over at zero health, restart/menu/index remain available.
- fail/friction state: enemy contact removes one heart with invulnerability; zero hearts opens a game-over overlay with final score and restart.

# Protected Mechanics
- Preserve world size, camera following, velocity/friction movement, spawn cadence, item cap, enemy cap, enemy pursuit, cone attack, pickup radius, score increment, health/fail/restart behavior, index persistence, and touch/keyboard controls.

# Safe Presentation Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/menu copy, palette, fonts from approved catalog, canvas background motifs, player/enemy/relic drawings, particle colors, toast wording, localStorage key name with fallback, and oscillator timbres are safe to transform.

# Remix Premise
A striped undead trickster explores a crooked afterlife mansion fused with a Halloween carnival, grabbing grotesque gag relics from the Handbook of Gags and scaring red-tape bureaucratic ghosts before they cut the trickster's Soul Strings.
